name_note: The GTDB name Ruminiclostridium_E siraeum refers to the species published as Eubacterium siraeum, also written [Eubacterium] siraeum; the NCBI name of the GTDB representative genome is [Eubacterium] siraeum.

sentences.text: Eubacterium siraeum is a bacterium from which a miniature Cas12f endonuclease of 433 amino acids, named EsCas12f1, was characterised and engineered.
One report describes Eubacterium siraeum as an asthma-associated species whose abundance in children could be predicted from the exhaled breath volatilome.
A study of two pig breeds identified Eubacterium siraeum as a strain linked to fat deposition, and reported that its metabolites curbed weight gain in mice.
